types.name: CountdownProps
types.doc: Use a countdown for a fixed moment people wait for: a launch, a live event, or a deadline.

members.name: target
members.doc: The moment to count down to. A number is epoch milliseconds, a Date is used as is, and an ISO string with `Z` or an offset such as `2026-10-06T10:00:00-07:00` is exact. A string without an offset is wall time in `timeZone`, or UTC when no zone is given, so the result never depends on the visitor's own time zone.

members.name: timeZone
members.doc: IANA zone for a target string without an offset, such as "America/Los_Angeles". Daylight saving is resolved for the target date.

members.name: units
members.doc: Units to show, largest first. The largest unit absorbs the rest, so hours can pass 24 when days are left out.

members.name: variant
members.doc: Large digits with unit labels, or one compact line for banners and table cells.

members.name: completeLabel
members.doc: Shown once the target passes. The digits morph into it.

members.name: onComplete
members.doc: Fires once, the moment the countdown reaches zero while mounted. It fires on time even when the tab is hidden.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name, such as "Keynote starts in".

members.name: clock
members.doc: Clock source in epoch milliseconds. Pass a server-synced clock when the visitor's device time cannot be trusted.
